customManagers.description: cclint is installed with `go install <module>@<tag>` in pre-commit and CI; neither is a manager Renovate parses, so the tag is tracked from the annotation comment above each pin.

packageRules.description: hook-runtime-py39 imports the hooks under the macOS system Python 3.9, and setup-python publishes 3.9 only up to ubuntu-24.04: never move that job's Python or runner.
